query: Review the src/panels module and tell me what's wrong with it. Nothing has changed there recently, I just want the code looked at.
expected_behavior: Canonical module-as-it-stands review. Must resolve and measure the target first, then triage lenses before launching finders.

query: Can you do a code review of the whole billing feature? Not a diff — the feature as it is today.
expected_behavior: Feature-scoped static review. The explicit 'not a diff' is what separates this from the built-in /code-review.

query: Find bugs in skills/aidex-conventions/scripts/validate.py
expected_behavior: Correctness lens over a single-file target. Should still measure and state the finder count rather than reading the file inline.

query: Quiero una revisión de código del módulo de guiones, sobre el módulo completo, no sobre los cambios.
expected_behavior: Canonical ES module-review imperative. Native-language query kept per D-11; the matcher bridges cross-lingually.

query: What dead code is sitting in the exporters package?
expected_behavior: simplify lens, dead-code angle. Findings must be reported, never deleted.

query: Can this module be simplified? There's a lot of duplication in the serializers.
expected_behavior: simplify lens over a named module — duplication-and-reuse plus altitude angles.

query: Do a security review of the auth module's code — I want the code read, not a pentest.
expected_behavior: security lens, code-reading. Must not route to the aidex-audit OWASP program playbook.

query: The reports page feels slow. Review that module's code for performance problems.
expected_behavior: perf lens, code-reading only. Every finding must argue magnitude at this module's scale.

query: Review the whole app for bugs.
expected_behavior: --app target. The resolver returns size_class=oversize with 0 finders; the skill must refuse a single run and propose a module split rather than sampling.

query: Revisa la calidad del código de este módulo y dime qué agentes lanzarías antes de lanzarlos.
expected_behavior: ES query exercising the triage-then-confirm mode explicitly. Must present lenses, angles, dropped angles and cost before running anything.

query: Review my changes before I commit.
expected_behavior: Working diff, not a module. The built-in /code-review owns the diff case; aidex-review must NOT fire.

query: Code review PR 412 please.
expected_behavior: Pull request scope. Belongs to the built-in /code-review or the code-review plugin.

query: Run /simplify on what I just wrote.
expected_behavior: Explicit built-in invocation over changed code. Deferring to the named instrument is correct.

query: I want a UX audit of the checkout flow before we ship.
expected_behavior: Project-state audit against a methodology playbook with tracked findings — aidex-audit, not a code read.

query: Audit the app's performance against our Lighthouse budgets and the RUM data.
expected_behavior: Measures a running system against budgets. The aidex-audit perf playbook owns this; aidex-review cannot measure, only read.

query: This endpoint returns a 500 on expired tokens. Fix it.
expected_behavior: One known bug with a reproduction — aidex-bugfix owns RED-first regression work.

query: Review the security of our dependency tree after that CVE announcement.
expected_behavior: Dependency scanning against a disclosure, not reading module code. aidex-audit security playbook.

query: What skills do I have installed, and is my .context/ a mess?
expected_behavior: Ecosystem audit of the Claude Code setup — aidex, not code review.

query: Necesito que ejecutes un AIDEX Review sobre todos los cambios realizados este fin de semana
expected_behavior: Native field query (usage-retro 2026-08-23, echo_lab 08-16: fired nothing). 'Review de los cambios' resolves to the MODULES the changes touched, reviewed as they stand — not a diff review; the skill must not bounce it to /code-review.

query: hazme un aidex review de lo que tocamos en la sesion de hoy
expected_behavior: Same shape, informal Spanish. Resolve today's touched files to their owning modules and review those as they stand.
